signature_features: 120 mm M256 smoothbore with bore evacuator and thermal shroud on a flat, wedge-faced turret with special armor
Long low turret with rear bustle rack and 6-barrel M250 smoke grenade launchers on each turret cheek
AGT1500 gas turbine: large rear grille louvers and flat rear deck with angled exhaust
Seven road wheels and two return rollers per side behind full-length armored side skirts with a hinged front skirt section
Commander cupola with .50 cal M2 and loader M240 mount; GPS (gunner primary sight) doghouse on right turret roof
